text.aria-label: Title text 'Leak share of group G1: events with a recipient among the 16 Primaries, against 20 placebo windows per event. A leak share of 0 means the donor's step vanishes from the sum; 1 means the sum shows the whole step. Placebo windows lie outside labelled events, not outside all events: NGED's labels are incomplete.'
text.tspan: Leak share of group G1: events with a recipient among the 16 Primaries, against 20 placebo windows per event.
A leak share of 0 means the donor's step vanishes from the sum; 1 means the sum shows the whole step.
Placebo windows lie outside labelled events, not outside all events: NGED's labels are incomplete.
